_doc: Facility-level profiles for gigafactories & cell plants (categories 28-30). Keyed by the exact cleaned plant name so each plant gets its own profile distinct from its parent company's Corporate entry. Capacity/investment figures are deliberately omitted (too many contested/revised numbers); scale is described qualitatively. See ENRICHMENT_PROMPT.md.

tesla gigafactory nevada.strategic_role: Tesla-Panasonic cell JV; one of the original Tesla gigafactories, supplying Model 3/Y and energy-storage products.

tesla gigafactory texas austin.strategic_role: Tesla's in-house 4680 cell production alongside Model Y assembly.

panasonic energy de soto kansas.strategic_role: Panasonic's second US cell plant, expanding capacity for EV customers including Tesla.

ultium cells warren ohio.strategic_role: General Motors-LG Energy Solution joint venture supplying GM's Ultium EV platform.

ultium cells spring hill tennessee.strategic_role: Second Ultium Cells JV plant supplying GM's Ultium EV platform.

blueoval sk glendale kentucky.strategic_role: Ford-SK On joint venture supplying Ford EVs.

blueoval city stanton tennessee.strategic_role: Part of Ford's BlueOval City EV campus; battery cells via the SK On joint venture.

sk on commerce georgia.strategic_role: SK On's own US plant, supplying Ford and Volkswagen.

lg energy solution holland michigan.strategic_role: LG Energy Solution's original US plant (formerly LG Chem).

lg energy solution queen creek arizona.strategic_role: New LGES plant for cylindrical cells serving multiple customers.

starplus energy kokomo indiana.strategic_role: Stellantis-Samsung SDI joint venture supplying Stellantis EVs.

toyota battery manufacturing liberty nor.strategic_role: Toyota's own US battery plant supporting its North American EV/hybrid lineup.

envision aesc bowling green kentucky.strategic_role: Envision AESC US expansion supplying multiple automakers.

aesc smyrna tennessee.strategic_role: Originally Nissan's US plant supporting Leaf production; now operated by Envision AESC.

redwood materials storey county nevada.strategic_role: Recycles Li-ion batteries into recycled cathode and copper-foil materials, supplying Panasonic and others.

kore power koreplex buckeye arizona.strategic_role: Planned US cell plant that has faced funding delays.

our next energy van buren michigan.strategic_role: ONE's Michigan plant for its dual-chemistry Gemini pack and LFP cells.

microvast clarksville tennessee.strategic_role: Microvast's US cell plant for commercial-vehicle and industrial batteries.

l h battery jeffersonville ohio.strategic_role: LG Energy Solution-Honda joint venture supplying Honda EVs.

gotion manteno illinois.strategic_role: Planned Gotion cell plant in the US.

gotion big rapids michigan.strategic_role: Planned Gotion cathode/anode materials and cell plant; drew local political controversy.

statevolt imperial valley california.strategic_role: Planned plant tied to nearby Salton Sea lithium extraction projects.

freyr battery coweta county georgia.strategic_role: FREYR's US project, part of its shift in focus from Norway to the US.

amprius technologies brighton colorado.strategic_role: Amprius's silicon-anode cell production for aviation and other high-energy-density applications.

nextstar energy windsor ontario.strategic_role: LG Energy Solution-Stellantis joint venture; Canada's first large-scale EV battery gigafactory.

volkswagen powerco st thomas ontario.strategic_role: Volkswagen's first North American in-house cell plant.

northvolt six montreal quebec.strategic_role: Planned Canadian plant; timeline uncertain amid Northvolt's 2024 financial restructuring (Chapter 11 in the US).

ultium cam b cancour quebec.strategic_role: General Motors-POSCO joint venture producing cathode active material for Ultium Cells plants.

lion electric mirabel quebec.facility_type: EV manufacturing & battery-pack assembly (not cell production)
lion electric mirabel quebec.strategic_role: Lion Electric's electric truck/bus plant, including battery-pack assembly.

northvolt ett skellefte.strategic_role: Northvolt's first and most established plant, though the parent company has faced serious financial restructuring since 2024.

northvolt drei heide.strategic_role: Planned German Northvolt plant; construction has faced delays amid the parent's financial difficulties.

tesla gigafactory berlin brandenburg.strategic_role: Tesla's European vehicle-assembly plant with 4680 cell pilot production.

volkswagen powerco salzgitter.strategic_role: Volkswagen's first European in-house ('unified') cell plant.

mercedes benz kamenz.strategic_role: Mercedes-Benz's long-standing pack-assembly plant, operated by its ACCUMOTIVE subsidiary.

customcells itzehoe.strategic_role: German niche cell maker for aerospace, motorsport and high-performance applications.

cellforce group kirchentellinsfurt.strategic_role: Porsche-backed venture producing high-performance cells for motorsport and low-volume applications.

leclanch willst tt.strategic_role: Leclanché's German plant supplying marine and stationary battery systems.

automotive cells company kaiserslautern.strategic_role: Second ACC plant; timeline has been adjusted amid slower European EV demand.

automotive cells company termoli.strategic_role: Third ACC plant; timeline has been adjusted amid slower European EV demand.

verkor dunkirk.strategic_role: Verkor's flagship French gigafactory, backed by Renault.

prologium dunkirk.strategic_role: Planned French solid-state cell plant; the project has faced funding delays.

volkswagen powerco sagunto valencia.strategic_role: Volkswagen's Spanish cell plant, part of a broader Spanish EV/battery investment with SEAT.

italvolt scarmagno.strategic_role: Planned Italian gigafactory that has faced significant funding difficulties.

lg energy solution wroc aw.strategic_role: One of Europe's largest established battery plants, supplying many European automakers.

freyr mo i rana.strategic_role: FREYR's original Norwegian project; paused as the company shifted its primary focus to the US.

aesc sunderland.strategic_role: Long-standing UK plant supporting Nissan Leaf production, undergoing expansion.

agratas bridgwater somerset.strategic_role: Tata's dedicated battery subsidiary building the UK's largest planned gigafactory.

britishvolt blyth.strategic_role: UK gigafactory project that collapsed into administration in January 2023; assets acquired by Recharge Industries.

amte power dundee.strategic_role: UK cell-plant project; AMTE Power entered administration in 2024.

catl ningde fujian.strategic_role: CATL's original flagship plant and headquarters campus.

catl yibin sichuan.strategic_role: Major CATL plant noted for running on renewable (hydro) power.

byd shenzhen.strategic_role: Home base of BYD's battery arm, FinDreams Battery, maker of the Blade Battery.

gotion high tech hefei.strategic_role: Gotion's headquarters and main production base.

lg energy solution nanjing.strategic_role: One of LG Energy Solution's largest plants globally.

tesla megafactory shanghai.strategic_role: Produces Tesla Megapack grid-storage units, distinct from the separate Gigafactory Shanghai vehicle plant.

lg energy solution ochang.strategic_role: One of LG Energy Solution's original, major Korean plants.

samsung sdi cheonan.strategic_role: Major Samsung SDI Korean production base.

sk on seosan.strategic_role: SK On's major Korean production base.

envision aesc ibaraki.strategic_role: Envision AESC's original Japanese plant, formerly a Nissan/AESC site.

gs yuasa kyoto.strategic_role: GS Yuasa's established Japanese plant, spanning automotive and industrial batteries.

toshiba scib yokohama.strategic_role: Produces Toshiba's SCiB fast-charging lithium-titanate cells.

ola electric gigafactory krishnagiri tam.strategic_role: Ola Electric's Indian cell plant, initially focused on two-wheelers.

reliance new energy jamnagar gujarat.strategic_role: Part of Reliance Industries' broader green-energy investment plans.

amara raja giga telangana.strategic_role: Amara Raja's planned Indian cell plant.

vinfast ha tinh.strategic_role: VinFast's battery subsidiary VinES, supplying VinFast's EVs.

hli green power karawang.strategic_role: Hyundai-LG Energy Solution joint venture; Indonesia's first large-scale EV battery cell plant.

energy absolute chachoengsao.strategic_role: Thai battery plant operated via Energy Absolute's Amita Technology venture.

recharge industries geelong.strategic_role: Australian project by the company that also acquired Britishvolt's assets.

energy renaissance tomago.strategic_role: Planned Australian LFP battery assembly plant.
